newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Changchai outlines dividend plans.
newsitem.headline: Changchai outlines dividend plans.

text.p: Diesel engine maker Changchai Co Ltd has drafted different dividend distribution proposals for its holders of A and B shares, company spokesman Jiang Guanqun said on Friday.

Jiang told the Hong Kong-based newsletter China Securities Bulletin that based on Changchai's forecast 1996 net profits of 250 million yuan, or 0.876 yuan per share, distributable profits to A share holders would reach about 0.74 yuan per share.
Distributable profits to B shareholders would reach only about 0.23 yuan per share, Jiang said.
Distributable profits to A shareholders in 1996 would include some profits not distributed last year, he added.
Holders of B shares are only entitled to Changchai's profits racked up in the fourth quarter of this year as Changchai's 100 million B shares were listed last month, Jiang said.
The proposals were approved by Changchai's shareholders at a meeting on Friday, he said.
Jiang said Changchai had booked net earnings of nearly 200 million yuan in the January-September period and that surpassing the annual profit target should be easy.

Changchai said in its interim report that under Chinese accounting standards, it generated after-tax profits of 125.99 million yuan in the first six months of 1996, compared with 87.53 million yuan in the first half of last year.
